geometry.position: one separate effective pool at each frozen target RGC representative RF coordinate; no AC cell density claim
geometry.input_kernel: Gaussian weighted by original BC group member counts, unit DC on full parent before selection
geometry.output_kernel: one-to-one delta from effective pool to its owning target representative

C_gL_EL.source: Xu and Beyeler 2023, doi:10.3389/fnins.2023.1147729, passive amacrine model / user-selected Chat plan

theta_k.rationale: threshold -40mV and smooth 5mV scale fixed before first new-model run

alpha_beta.rationale: equal fixed 100/s opening and closing; effective gate tau 5..10ms, distinct from old 10ms h assumption

G_BA_G_AR.rationale: 2nS BC fractional-input scale and 0.4nS per target member output; independent channel fields, no secondary-path strength assumed

EI.rule: read each target's actual EI; do not add AII direct input

geometry.rationale: fixed finite 0.1deg BC support, 0.04deg sigma; no broad or active integration claim

parameter_ledger.scale_gauge: C/gL/reversals/threshold/slope/input weights/all gains fixed; s in [0,1]; no output_scale or optimizer in this task

legacy_S_ON: original local_feedforward_AC h, original ON diffuse BC input and original S-ON output gain/state retained separately
